claims.text: The hotel sits on the banks of the Kamogawa River, on a site favored by Japanese nobility since the 17th century, with views of the Higashiyama Mountains.

findings.quote: The Ritz-Carlton, Kyoto sits on the banks of the Kamogawa River—a site favored by Japanese nobility since the 17th century—offering sweeping views of the magical Higashiyama Mountains.

claims.text: The Gion and Teramachi districts, known for shopping and entertainment, are within walking distance of the hotel.

findings.quote: The Gion and Teramachi districts, known for refined shopping and entertainment, are within walking distance of the hotel.

claims.text: The hotel is a seven-level structure, two floors of which are sunken to harmonise with Kyoto's low-rise cityscape.

findings.quote: seven-level structure, two floors of which are sunken (to harmonise with Kyoto’s low-rise cityscape)

claims.text: A waterfall flows from the upper levels of the hotel all the way down to the basement.

findings.quote: a waterfall flowing from the upper levels all the way down to the basement

claims.text: Some suites are Japanese-style rooms with tatami floors, futons and a deep hinoki bathtub.

findings.quote: Step inside to discover a choice between sleek, modern suites and traditional Japanese-style rooms. The latter feature tatami floors, plush futons, and deep hinoki bathtub

claims.text: Every guest room has a pruned bonsai by the window.

findings.quote: center stage by the window, a perfectly pruned bonsai (yes, one in every room)

claims.text: La Locanda serves Italian dishes made from locally sourced ingredients in a setting of wood-paneling with tatami mats.

findings.quote: Our Italian restaurant in Kyoto, La Locanda, showcases Italian dishes made from locally sourced ingredients in an elegant setting of wood-paneling with tatami mats.

claims.text: The sushi restaurant serves Edomae-style sushi at an 11-meter-long counter decorated with Wajima lacquerware.

findings.quote: you can enjoy Edomae-style sushi at the 11-meter-long counter, fully decorated with Wajima lacquerware.

claims.text: The hotel is home to one of the few PIERRE HERMÉ PARIS boutiques in Japan.

findings.quote: The resort is also home to one of the few PIERRE HERMÉ PARIS boutiques in all of Japan

claims.text: The wellness area has a heated indoor pool, a steam room and a dry sauna.

findings.quote: let your cares fade in the heated indoor 20-meter pool, the steam room, or the dry sauna.

claims.text: The hotel has Asia's first LA PRAIRIE SPA hotel spa.

findings.quote: Immerse yourself in Asia’s first LA PRAIRIE SPA hotel spa.

claims.text: Chef Katsuhito Inoue's chef's table is designed for an intimate group of eight guests.

findings.quote: Designed for an intimate group of eight

claims.text: Suite TSUKIMI is a penthouse retreat atop the hotel with views of the Higashiyama Mountains.

findings.quote: Perched atop the hotel, Suite TSUKIMI offers a serene penthouse retreat with breathtaking views of the Higashiyama Mountains.

claims.text: The pouch given to guests at check-in is made from old kimono textiles and reused wood from Kyoto bridge construction.

findings.quote: the pouch given to guests upon check-in, crafted from old kimono textiles and reused wood from Kyoto bridge construction

claims.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service.

findings.quote: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

claims.text: Children under 4 years old are not allowed to use the pool.

findings.quote: Children under 4 years old are not allowed to use the pool.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
